services.name: Bottom Fishing Charters
services.desc: Bottom fishing off Fort Lauderdale is where steady action meets dinner-quality fish. The reefs and wrecks east of the beach hold mangrove snapper, yellowtail snapper, mutton snapper, and four kinds of grouper, plus the bigger fights when amberjack and cobia move in on the wrecks. Our Fort Lauderdale bottom fishing charters are the right call when you want a cooler full of fillets without a long offshore run. Trips depart from the Cox Landing with a quick run to the structure that produces. blurb: Guests fish offshore for sailfish, mahi, tuna, wahoo, and marlin; inshore for snook, tarpon, redfish, and seatrout; or bottom fish over reefs and wrecks for snapper, grouper, amberjack, and triggerfish. Trips run out of Cox Landing and cover areas from Boca Raton to Miami. Captain Jason provides rods, reels, tackle, bait, ice, coolers, and cleans and bags the catch at the dock.
extraNote: Captain decides based on morning forecast and offshore wave reports · If conditions unsafe, reschedule with no penalty · If conditions marginal, may switch trip type · The trip works year-round here, with the reef bite staying productive through almost any weather window where we can safely make the run. · Reschedules for weather are at no charge. · We look forward to having you as our guest! · Pickup at Cox Landing dock in Fort Lauderdale; exact dock and time confirmed when booking.
